title: JSON responses with Prisma results throw 'Do not know how to serialize a BigInt' or turn Decimals into strings
symptoms: TypeError: Do not know how to serialize a BigInt
A Decimal(10,2) value of 1.50 arrives in the JSON as the string "1.5"
cause: BigInt columns come back as JavaScript bigint, which JSON.stringify cannot encode. Decimal columns come back as Decimal.js objects whose JSON form is a string without the column's scale.
fix: Convert both at the API boundary with a replacer or explicit mapping.
affected: Prisma ORM 6 and 7, reproduced on 7.10.0 with @prisma/adapter-pg
